data.body: Operator ruling 2026-09-08: proceed with Option A. Configure Gerrit→GitHub replication to publish refs/changes/* to the GitHub mirror, preserving the pinned checkout-gerrit-change-action mirror-first path. Patchset visibility on the org-private GitHub mirror is acceptable. Implementation should avoid disturbing main/tickets replication, apply with minimal downtime via replication plugin reload where possible, trigger full replication, verify refs/changes/* on the mirror, prove Verified checkout can fetch refs/changes from origin without Gerrit, watch Mirror Guard, then close with evidence.
